title: Interpret the Anchor
text: The caret ** anchors the match to the beginning of the string, so the regex starts checking from the first character of review\_3.

title: First Four Characters
text: What are the first four characters of review\_3?

title: Apply \D{4}
text: \D means a non-digit character, and {4} means exactly four of them. The first four characters are I, $$t$$, ', and s, so the returned list is ["It's"].
